questions.question: When some people brought a blind man to Jesus at Bethsaida, what did they beg Jesus to do?
After Jesus healed a blind man at Bethsaida, what did He tell the man as He sent him home?

answers.text: Do not go back into the village
Go tell everyone in the village
Go show yourself to the priests

questions.question: A blind man healed by Jesus first saw people who looked like trees walking around. What did Jesus do next?

answers.text: Placed His hands on his eyes again
Sent him to wash in a pool
Told him to come back later

questions.question: When Jesus first placed His hands on a blind man's eyes at Bethsaida, the man could at once see everything clearly. True or false?
